result.summary: Removes dead code, unused parameters, and outdated docstrings left over from legacy wallet support across three wallet functional tests. In `wallet_address_types.py`, it drops an unreachable multisig branch and its corresponding test helper logic. In `wallet_backup.py` and `wallet_hd.py`, it updates the docstring to match current RPC usage and removes an ineffective `-keypool=0` argument.
result.problem: After legacy wallet support was removed from Bitcoin Core, several functional tests retained dead code paths, obsolete configuration flags, and docstrings describing legacy wallet commands. Developers reading or modifying these tests encounter misleading documentation and dead code.
evidence: Commit 164894d934 notes that `do_multisigs = [False]` rendered the multisig branch unreachable and broken after legacy wallet tests were removed in c847dee148.
PR description notes that coverage does not change because `wallet_address_types.py` runs the identical 8 send iterations before and after.
result.card: This PR cleans up legacy wallet leftovers in three functional test scripts: wallet_address_types.py, wallet_backup.py, and wallet_hd.py. It removes an unreachable multisig code path left behind when legacy wallet tests were dropped, corrects an outdated docstring referencing dumpwallet/importwallet, and drops a redundant -keypool=0 option. It resolves technical debt and misleading comments in the test suite without altering test coverage.

risk.why: Modifies only functional tests and documentation comments with no changes to node behavior or test coverage.
